title: Headcount & Attrition
note: Computed by checks_dashboards_demo.py from the frozen .psv rows, with the same definitions truths.out uses. Each value carries the SQL it came from; Phase B2 holds every widget to these numbers.

kpis.label: Headcount
kpis.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.employees e JOIN dash_demo.departments d USING (department_id) WHERE true AND e.hire_date <= DATE '2026-09-30' AND (e.termination_date IS NULL OR e.termination_date > DATE '2026-09-30')

kpis.label: Hires YTD
kpis.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.employees e JOIN dash_demo.departments d USING (department_id) WHERE true AND e.hire_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND e.hire_date <= DATE '2026-09-30'

kpis.label: Leavers YTD
kpis.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.employees e JOIN dash_demo.departments d USING (department_id) WHERE true AND e.termination_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND e.termination_date <= DATE '2026-09-30'

kpis.label: Attrition %
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.employees e JOIN dash_demo.departments d USING (department_id) WHERE true AND e.termination_date >= DATE '2026-09-30' - INTERVAL 365 DAY AND e.termination_date <= DATE '2026-09-30') / (SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.employees e JOIN dash_demo.departments d USING (department_id) WHERE true AND e.hire_date <= DATE '2026-09-30' AND (e.termination_date IS NULL OR e.termination_date > DATE '2026-09-30')), 2)

kpis.label: Customer Support pay against the same level elsewhere
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN department_id = 6 THEN base_salary_annual END) / avg(CASE WHEN department_id <> 6 THEN base_salary_annual END), 2) FROM dash_demo.employees WHERE level IN ('L1', 'L2', 'L3')

density.bucket: department bar, departments under 8 leavers folded into Other departments
density.rule: each attrition bar stands on at least 8 leavers over the period
density.sql: SELECT min(n) FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM dash_demo.employees e JOIN dash_demo.departments d USING (department_id) WHERE e.termination_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.employees e2 WHERE e2.department_id = e.department_id AND e2.termination_date IS NOT NULL) >= 8 THEN d.name ELSE 'Other departments' END)
